items.title: Postgame Notes: #6 Indiana 13, Michigan 6
items.summary: Michigan's defense kept No. 6 Indiana out of the end zone in regulation and held the Hoosiers to just 81 passing yards before the Wolverines fell in overtime at Michigan Stadium. Zeke Berry recorded his fourth career interception to set up U-M's lone touchdown, while Tommy Carr threw for 167 yards in his first career start.

items.title: Rushing Attack, Turnovers Lead Michigan Past Penn State for First Big Ten Win
items.summary: All three of Michigan's touchdowns came in the second half via the ground game, with three different players finding the end zone, and the Wolverines held off a late charge from Penn State to seal the victory.

items.title: Postgame Notes: Michigan 21, Penn State 18
items.summary: Michigan came alive after halftime, scoring all 21 of its points and rushing for 174 yards in the second half to earn its first Big Ten win of the season. Tommy Carr sparked the Wolverines in his first significant action at quarterback, while the defense forced three turnovers to help seal the victory.
